purpose: Retain the complete fixed 30-row Wave-1 projected comparison bundle as a small independent overlay after the original five raw-evidence archives are accepted.

relationship_to_raw_archive.overlay_contains: the complete projection controller root, projected CSVs, manifests, SHA-256 inventories, and terminal marker

start_condition: the original raw Wave-1 archive root is TERMINAL_ACCEPTED and its inventory validates
the v2 projection root is TERMINAL_ACCEPTED and its recursive inventory validates
the fresh overlay archive root is absent
data2 has at least projection source bytes plus 2 GiB free

archive_format.metadata_normalization: sorted paths, mtime zero, numeric owner/group zero, atime/ctime omitted

transfer.resume: get -p for a fresh partial and reget -p for an existing SHA-derived partial
transfer.acceptance: the local archive SHA-256 must equal the remote manifest SHA-256 before partial promotion

acceptance: the archive contains only the complete projection root
the archive listing is nonempty and every entry is beneath the frozen projection-root name
the archive and archive manifest SHA-256 values validate
both the raw evidence archive and source projection remain present
failure_semantics: Preserve the fresh overlay archive root and any partial file with TERMINAL_REJECTED; no failed archive authorizes source deletion.
cleanup_boundary: This stage authorizes no deletion. Both Wave-1 models are shared pre-existing assets and remain permanently excluded from project cleanup.
prohibited: replacing or mutating any of the original five raw-evidence archives
using SCP, rsync, HTTP, or an unthrottled payload transfer
deleting source runs, projected tables, archive partials, datasets, logs, manifests, or models
